1053.description: A lunge-style stretch on one knee that lengthens the front of the hip. It helps with tightness from sitting.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.

1117.description: Holding the straps for balance, you squat and jump explosively to build leg power.
instructions: Hold the handles with slightly bent arms and stand tall.
Lower into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your feet and jump up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink into the next squat.
Use the straps for balance only.
Keep knees tracking over toes.

1181.description: A lying leg raise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors while you keep your legs long.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.

1245.description: Raising your legs from the floor and holding them up. It targets the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs until they are vertical.
Lower them to just above the floor and hold for a couple of seconds.
Repeat without letting your back arch.

1309.description: A smith machine bench press on a decline bench with a wide grip. It targets the lower chest along a guided bar path.
instructions: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows pointed outwards.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将下斜凳调整至所需角度。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
宽握距抓住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃并将其慢慢降低到胸部，保持肘部朝外。
当杠铃触及胸部时暂停片刻。
将杠铃推回到起始位置，完全伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1373.description: A standing calf raise using just your body weight. It strengthens the calves and ankles and needs no equipment.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on a wall or stable surface for balance.
Slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾指向前方。
将手放在墙壁或稳定的表面上以保持平衡。
慢慢地将脚后跟抬离地面，将身体重量转移到脚掌上。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1437.description: Small dumbbell curls where the bar rolls down to your fingertips and back up. A simple way to build finger and forearm grip strength.
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, resting your forearm on your thigh, palm facing up.
Allow the dumbbell to roll down to your fingertips, then curl it back up by flexing your fingers.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other hand.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳或椅子上，双脚平放在地上，背部挺直。
一只手握住哑铃，反手握住，将前臂放在大腿上，手掌朝上。
让哑铃向下滚动到指尖，然后弯曲手指将其卷起。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换另一只手。

1501.description: A side plank with a rowing motion against a band held by a partner. It trains the lats and trunk stability.
instructions: Get into a side plank on one forearm, with a partner holding the band in front of you.
Grip the band with your top hand and keep your hips lifted.
Row your hand back toward your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Return slowly without letting your hips drop.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

1565.description: A clean that starts from a dead stop on the floor each rep, with no swing. It builds explosive hip drive and pulling power.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell with feet hip-width apart and hinge down to grab the handle.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand around the handle and catch the bell at your shoulder.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset before the next rep.

1629.description: A standing barbell curl with a wide grip. It puts more load on the inner biceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your torso.
Exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，反握握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
保持背部挺直，肘部靠近躯干。
呼气并将杠铃向上弯向肩膀，保持上臂静止。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置，充分伸展双臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

1693.description: A single-leg hip hinge holding a medicine ball that trains the hamstrings, glutes and balance.
instructions: Hold a medicine ball at your chest and stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the ball toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

1757.description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a dumbbell. Works the glutes and hamstrings and improves balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight behind you, maintaining a slight bend in your left knee.
Lower the dumbbell until your torso and right leg are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立，右手握住哑铃。
将体重转移到左腿上，并将右脚稍微抬离地面。
保持背部挺直，臀部向前转动，将哑铃放低至地面。
同时，将右腿伸直在身后，保持左膝轻微弯曲。
降低哑铃，直到躯干和右腿与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后收紧臀肌和腿筋，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1821.description: Straightening your elbow and rotating your forearm stretches the muscles on both sides of the lower arm.
instructions: Extend one arm in front of you with your elbow straight.
Slowly rotate your palm up and down and let your other hand add gentle pressure at each end.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1885.description: Stretches the calf and Achilles by lifting the toes against a wall.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward.
Place the ball of the forward foot against the wall, heel on the floor.
Lean your hips toward the wall.
Feel the stretch in the calf and Achilles.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

1949.description: A standing lunge-style stretch for the front of the hip and thigh.
instructions: Stand and step one foot forward and the other back into a staggered stance.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips slightly forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your torso upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2141.description: Smooth walking-style motion on an elliptical cross trainer. Low-impact cardio that builds endurance.
instructions: Adjust the resistance level and incline of the elliptical machine to your desired settings.
Step onto the pedals of the machine and grip the handles lightly.
Begin by pushing down with your feet and pulling the handles towards your body.
Continue this motion, alternating between pushing and pulling, to simulate a walking or running motion.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the intensity and speed of the machine before stepping off.
instructionsZh: 将椭圆机的阻力水平和倾斜度调整到您想要的设置。
踩上机器的踏板并轻轻握住手柄。
首先用脚向下压，然后将手柄拉向身体。
继续这个动作，交替推和拉，以模拟行走或跑步动作。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的步伐并保持核心参与。
继续进行有氧运动所需的持续时间。
下车前逐渐降低机器的强度和速度。

2205.description: A kneeling roller stretch that opens the hips and glutes. Helps release tension around the hips.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the ground with the roller positioned under your hips.
Place your hands on the roller for support.
Slowly roll the roller forward, extending your hips and stretching your glutes.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then roll back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地上，将滚轮放在臀部下方。
将双手放在滚轮上以获得支撑。
慢慢地向前滚动滚轮，伸展臀部并伸展臀部。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后滚回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2269.description: A crunch done with an ab wheel that works the abdominal wall through a compact range.
instructions: Kneel on a mat and hold the ab wheel with both hands in front of your knees.
Round your lower back slightly and brace your abs.
Roll forward a short distance while keeping your hips stable.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees by curling your ribs toward your hips.
Exhale as you crunch and avoid arching your back.
Repeat with smooth control.

2333.description: A hanging straight-leg raise. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors and challenges your grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your legs straight down.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 悬挂在引体向上杆上，双臂完全伸展，双腿伸直向下。
启动你的核心并将双腿抬起到你面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部保持片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2397.description: A seated dumbbell press from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将哑铃举至肩部高度，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2461.description: Lying on your side with knees bent, you open the top knee like a clam to strengthen the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet stacked, head on your arm.
Keep your hips stacked and your core lightly braced.
Lift the top knee while keeping your feet together.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

2525.description: A standing hold on a vibrating platform that engages the legs and core.
instructions: Step onto the vibrating plate with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Hold your posture tall and your core braced.
Keep your weight balanced over your feet.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Step off carefully.

2589.description: A classic lying extension that isolates the triceps by bending only at the elbows.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.

2717.description: Holding weights out to your sides at shoulder height, building shoulder endurance.
instructions: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides until level with your shoulders.
Hold the position with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and wrists straight.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.

2781.description: Moving the arm backward in a horizontal arc, working the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out in front at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm out and back in a horizontal arc as far as is comfortable.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2845.description: A seated twist with the legs lifted, working the obliques and core.
instructions: Sit with your hands behind you and legs lifted.
Keep your chest open.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Circle your legs back to the centre.
Switch sides.

2909.description: A pull from low to chest height on a sled, using hip drive. It trains the shoulders and upper back with a bit of power.
instructions: Stand facing the sled and hold the handles or rope with arms long.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and pull the handles up toward your chest, elbows high.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

3037.description: A running drill where your heels flick up toward your glutes. It warms up the hamstrings and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Jog on the spot or move forward slowly.
Kick each heel up toward your glute.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Pump your arms in rhythm.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

3165.description: A standing row done with both hands on a towel, pulling toward your chest. It trains the upper back and shoulder blade squeeze with no gear.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a towel in front of you with both hands.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the towel towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手握住毛巾放在身前。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将毛巾拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点停顿片刻，然后慢慢释放张力，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3229.description: A lying back extension where you also press your arms forward at the top. It adds shoulder work to a back extension.
instructions: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.

3293.description: A wide pull-up where you pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. It builds lat strength on the way to the one arm pull-up.
instructions: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
As you pull yourself up, bend one arm and bring your elbow towards your side, while keeping the other arm straight.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar and your bent arm is fully flexed.
Lower yourself back down with control, straightening the bent arm and repeating the movement on the other side.
Alternate sides with each repetition.
instructionsZh: 首先，用正手握法悬挂在引体向上杆上，握距略宽于肩宽。
启动你的核心并将肩胛骨向下拉和向后拉。
当你站起来时，弯曲一只手臂并将肘部移向身体一侧，同时保持另一只手臂伸直。
继续拉，直到下巴位于杠铃上方并且弯曲的手臂完全弯曲。
有控制地放低自己，伸直弯曲的手臂并在另一侧重复该动作。
每次重复时交替进行。

3357.description: A floor seated cable row using a rope, which lets you pull the hands apart and squeeze the mid back.
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with legs extended and the rope in your hands.
Sit tall with a straight back.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest, spreading your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly and repeat.

3485.description: A home row where you hang under a bar or broom handle set across two chairs, knees bent to make it easier. It trains the back and biceps.
instructions: Set a sturdy bar across two stable chairs and lie underneath it.
Grip the bar overhand, arms straight, knees bent and feet flat.
Keep your body in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest up toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

3677.description: Jump rope while driving your knees high for a hard cardio effort.
instructions: Hold the rope handles and swing the rope overhead.
Run over the rope.
Lift your knees to hip height.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your torso upright.

3741.description: A no-equipment side raise using a towel for resistance, so you can train the delts at home.
instructions: Hold a towel with both hands and stand on its middle with one foot, or pull its ends apart.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep tension on the towel throughout.

3869.description: A seated fly on the cable machine that isolates the chest with constant tension.
instructions: Sit on a bench between two cable stacks with the pulleys at chest height.
Grab a handle in each hand and hold your arms out with soft elbows.
Press your back firmly into the bench.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze, then open your arms slowly.
Stop when you feel a good stretch.

3997.description: Bend sideways with one arm overhead and bent. It stretches the side of the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Bend one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

4061.description: Squat to a bench with bands adding tension. It teaches depth control and builds the glutes and thighs.
instructions: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back with bands attached.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees pushing out.
Drive through your heels to stand.

4125.description: A face down press on an incline bench that works the rear shoulder.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells at ear height.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly back.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the bench.

4189.description: Roll the EZ bar forward from a kneeling position and back. It strongly challenges the core.
instructions: Kneel holding the EZ bar on the floor.
Brace your core.
Roll forward with a flat back.
Stop before your back sags.
Pull the bar back to the start.
Keep your hips in line.

4253.description: A crunch holding a medicine ball for extra resistance. It targets the abs with a simple, adjustable load.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a medicine ball against your chest or overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Reach the ball toward your knees.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

4381.description: A restful pose where your legs rest up a wall, gently stretching the backs of the legs and easing tension in the lower back.
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall and lie back as you swing your legs up the wall.
Move your hips close to the wall, with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Keep your knees soft if the hamstrings feel tight.
Breathe slowly and relax your shoulders and jaw.
Hold for 1-5 minutes, then bend your knees and roll to one side to come up.

4445.description: A seated band pull toward the face that targets the rear delts and upper back. Good for shoulder health and posture.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and sit facing it, holding the ends with both hands.
Sit tall with arms extended and the band under light tension.
Pull the band toward your face, flaring your elbows out and high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Pause briefly, then return slowly with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

4509.description: A gentle neck stretch that lengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Useful after long periods of sitting.
instructions: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Place your hands lightly on the back of your head if you want a deeper stretch.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to neutral.

4573.description: A band chop from a half kneeling position, building core stability and rotation.
instructions: Anchor a band high and kneel on one knee side-on to the anchor.
Hold the band with both hands near your high shoulder.
Pull the band diagonally down across your body.
Rotate your torso and keep your hips square.
Return slowly to the start.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

4701.description: A leg lift from a face-down position against a band. It trains the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down with a band looped around one foot and anchored under you.
Rest your arms under your head.
Lift one leg up, keeping it straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, repeat, then switch legs.

4765.description: A one-leg hyperextension on the glute ham bench. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings and the lower back.
instructions: Set up on the bench with one foot planted and the other lifted behind you.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise to a straight line, squeezing your glute.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

4829.description: Skipping rope with a jump on each turn. It builds stamina, coordination and calf strength.
instructions: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows near your sides.
Swing the rope over your head using your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds, rest, and repeat.

4893.description: A kneeling cable triceps extension done in a short range at the lockout. It isolates the triceps.
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps at the bottom.
Let the hands rise only halfway, keeping tension.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.

4957.description: A lat pulldown done lying down. It trains the lats with a different angle.
instructions: Lie on a bench under a high pulley.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull the bar down toward your chest.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly with straight arms.
Keep your core braced.

5213.description: A mountain climber in plank position, a second variation. It raises your heart rate and works the core.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and level.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

5277.description: A step-up that emphasises the glutes by leaning slightly forward. It builds single-leg strength.
instructions: Stand in front of a bench and place one foot on it.
Lean your torso slightly forward.
Press through your heel and step up until standing.
Lower slowly back down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

5405.description: A standing side bend with a stick raised overhead. Lengthens the side of your trunk and the lats.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hold the stick overhead.
Keep your arms straight and your chest open.
Bend slowly to one side without leaning forward.
Hold for 15-20 seconds.
Return to center and bend to the other side.

5469.description: A curl format with seven bottom-half reps, seven top-half reps and seven full reps using dumbbells.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl from the bottom to halfway up for 7 reps.
Curl from halfway to the top for 7 reps.
Do 7 full-range curls.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Use a lighter weight than normal.

5661.description: Chest-supported dumbbell row to reduce lower back stress.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells.
Let your arms hang.
Row the weights up toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

5853.description: A row lying chest-down on an incline bench with elbows flared. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the bar up with elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

5917.description: Lying on your back and holding your feet with knees wide. Opens the hips and relaxes the lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your knees toward your chest.
Hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wide toward your armpits.
Rock gently side to side and hold for 5 slow breaths.
Release your feet and rest.

5981.description: A more powerful flow that adds chair pose and warrior I. Builds heat and leg strength.
instructions: Stand in mountain pose and sit into a chair pose with your arms overhead.
Fold forward, step back to plank and flow through chaturanga.
Press to downward dog.
Step forward into warrior I on each side, then flow again.
Link every move to your breath.

6045.description: A wide-stance squat holding a weighted bottle between your legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding a bottle with both hands in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower your hips straight down.
Keep your knees pushing out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels and squeeze your glutes.

6237.description: A one-arm curl on a ring. It builds the biceps with a lot of control.
instructions: Hold one ring and lean back.
Extend your arm.
Curl your hand toward your head.
Keep your elbow up.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

6301.description: A balancing pose with legs and arms wrapped. It stretches the hips and shoulders and trains balance.
instructions: Stand and bend your knees slightly.
Cross one thigh over the other, hooking the foot behind the calf if you can.
Wrap your arms, one under the other, palms together.
Sit your hips low and lift your elbows.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

6365.description: A wrist curl with the EZ bar held behind your back, training your forearms and grip.
instructions: Stand holding an EZ bar behind your back with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows still and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to raise the bar slightly.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

6749.description: A seated rotation turning the thigh outward. It improves hip mobility and activates the deep rotators.
instructions: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

6813.description: The barbell bench press seen from the side to check bar path and form. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Touch lightly and press back up over your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.

7389.description: A standing plank against a wall, an easy way to learn core bracing.
instructions: Stand facing a wall and place your forearms or hands on it.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a slanted line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your head neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Step in to finish.

7517.description: Advanced single-arm pull on a ring that demands serious back and arm strength.
instructions: Hang from one ring with a firm grip.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Pull your chin up toward the ring.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Complete reps, then switch arms.

7581.description: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell in the opposite hand to the working leg.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the opposite leg.
Lower until the back knee nears the floor.
Push through the front foot.
Finish reps and switch sides.

8221.description: In a plank, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It challenges the core and shoulders together.
instructions: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Brace your core and widen your feet.
Lift one dumbbell out to the side.
Avoid twisting your hips.
Lower and alternate arms.

9181.description: Using a stick to guide the arm, you rotate the shoulder outward. It improves external rotation range.
instructions: Stand holding a stick with both hands, elbows tucked at your sides and bent.
Push the stick with the stronger hand to rotate the other arm outward.
Keep your elbow glued to your side.
Move only as far as is comfortable.
Return to the start slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

9693.description: A squat into an overhead press, alternating arms with dumbbells. It works legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Drive up and press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it back to your shoulder as you squat again.
Alternate arms each rep.

9821.description: A plank with a leg lift into a mountain climber. It trains the core and raises the heart rate.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg straight back.
Bring that knee in toward your chest.
Return and switch legs.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.

10589.description: Lying on your back, raise a light stick from your hips to overhead. It helps shoulder mobility.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a stick with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick overhead as far as is comfortable.
Return to your thighs slowly.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

10781.description: Lying face down, you lift the head slightly to train the back of the neck.
instructions: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Use small, controlled reps.

10909.description: Circling both feet while seated. A simple way to mobilise the ankles.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair with both feet lifted off the floor.
Keep your knees still.
Circle both feet in the same direction, as wide as feels comfortable.
Reverse the direction after several turns.
Keep your breathing relaxed.

0029.description: A front squat with the bar racked on the shoulders in a clean grip. Trains the quads and glutes with an upright torso.
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell resting on your upper chest, with your elbows pointing forward.
Lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, as if you are sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower down, making sure your knees do not go past your toes.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to stand back up, extending your hips and knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先，双脚分开与肩同宽，将杠铃放在上胸部，肘部向前。
弯曲膝盖并将臀部向后推，降低身体，就像坐在椅子上一样。
下降时保持挺胸、背部挺直，确保膝盖不超过脚趾。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后用脚跟推动站起来，伸展臀部和膝盖。
重复所需的重复次数。

0093.description: A seated trunk rotation with a barbell on your shoulders while balancing on a stability ball. It works the obliques and balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with a barbell across your upper back and your feet wide.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Rotate your torso to one side without moving your hips.
Return to the centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.

0157.description: A deadlift using the cable stack. Trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the hips and knees, lowering your torso until your back is parallel to the ground.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your shoulders back.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift the cable handles, extending your hips and standing up straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the cable handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
弯曲臀部和膝盖，降低躯干，直到背部与地面平行。
正手握住电缆手柄，保持手臂伸直，肩膀向后。
调动臀肌和腿筋来抬起拉索手柄，伸展臀部并站直。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将缆索手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0221.description: A standing one-arm cable side bend. You bend sideways against the cable to work the obliques and the abs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a cable handle in one hand.
Place the other hand on your hip.
Engage your core and slowly bend sideways towards the hand holding the cable, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住电缆手柄。
将另一只手放在臀部上。
启动你的核心，慢慢向握住电缆的手侧弯，保持背部挺直。
在动作底部暂停片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

0285.description: A standing dumbbell curl that alternates arms. Each rep isolates the biceps through a full range.
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating arms.
instructionsZh: 站直，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂静止，呼气并弯举哑铃，同时收缩二头肌。
继续举起哑铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且哑铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，交替手臂。

0349.description: A lying forearm rotation with a dumbbell, turning the palm up. It trains the muscles that rotate the forearm and supports elbow and wrist control.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders by contracting your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，手掌朝上，双臂完全伸展。
保持上臂不动，收缩前臂，将哑铃向肩膀方向卷曲。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0413.description: Holding a dumbbell at your chest or sides, you squat down and stand back up. It builds the thighs and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃放在身体两侧。
保持胸部挺直，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖和臀部，降低身体，就像坐回椅子上一样。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0541.description: Hinge forward and row a kettlebell to your hip with one arm. Targets the lats and upper back while your core keeps you steady.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the kettlebell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat with the other arm.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃，正手握住。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将壶铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将壶铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边并用另一只手臂重复。

0605.description: Standing with pads on your shoulders, you rise onto your toes and lower back down. Isolates the calves.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整到您的高度，双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
将肩膀放在护垫下方，并握住手柄以保持稳定。
伸展脚踝，将脚后跟尽可能抬高。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢降低脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0669.description: You pull one arm across your chest to stretch the back of the shoulder. Hold it gently on each side.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your right arm across your chest, placing your left hand on your right elbow.
Gently pull your right arm towards your left shoulder, feeling a stretch in your right shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽。
将右臂伸过胸部，将左手放在右肘上。
轻轻地将右臂拉向左肩，感受右肩的拉伸。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，然后放松。
在另一侧重复。

0733.description: A step-up on a box or bench using one leg. It builds the legs and balance.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy step.
Place one foot fully on the step.
Press through that heel and stand up.
Bring the other foot up to the step.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

0861.description: A seated cable row, pulling the handles toward the torso. It trains the back and biceps.
instructions: Sit on the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在电缆划船机上，双脚平放在脚踏板上，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住手柄，保持背部挺直，肩膀放松。
将手柄拉向身体，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢松开手柄回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0989.description: A one-arm chest press with a band that adds a twist. It trains the chest and core.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at chest height.
Stand with your side facing the anchor point and grab the band with one hand.
Step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Bring your hand holding the band across your body, towards the opposite shoulder.
While maintaining tension in the band, push your hand forward and away from your body, extending your arm.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other hand.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在胸部高度的坚固锚点上。
站立，一侧面向锚点，用一只手抓住带子。
远离锚点以在带子中产生张力。
将双脚分开与肩同宽，并稍微弯曲膝盖。
将握住弹力带的手穿过身体，朝向对侧的肩膀。
在保持弹力带张力的同时，将手向前推离身体，伸展手臂。
慢慢回到起始位置并重复所需的重复次数。
换边并用另一只手重复练习。
